observation: Concept re-lock post-AQ1 ran on stable inputs (AQ1 already shipped, isolation boundary removed). The pipeline did not re-examine the central noun (Connection provisioning) or both satellites (provisioned connection, outbound MCP client) — re-lock was a simplification of Phase 4 deployment-shape only. This was correct but meant the architect's reconciliation load was lighter than a fresh concept would have been. Future re-locks should still exercise the full concept-locking gates (Phase 1-7, Phase 6 self-critique) even if the input was a simplification.

Stale worktree install (zod v3 shipped in node_modules vs declared v4) caused the builder's pre-check to report 5 type errors + 11 test failures as 'pre-existing on base' (false). npm ci fixed the state. The root: worktrees inherit node_modules from the host; rebasing onto dependency-changing commits requires a fresh install inside the worktree, not just npm ci verification from the old host state. This matches CC-005 pattern (worktree corruption).

Live-proof was theater in round 1: claude MCP connection silently failed but test passed (asserted only file-written, not tool-called); codex/opencode never spawned the binary (wrote a file, closed the test server, asserted file-shape). The single gate was 'does the config file exist' — not 'does the agent actually call a real MCP server with the held token'. Round 2-3 fixed this: both carriers now prove end-to-end authentication + tool retrieval via a tamper test (wrong token → RED). Cost: 2 review rounds to get genuine per-harness proof.

Dead env code (C2): plan.envInjections computed in connection-provisioning.ts but never merged into mcpTokenEnv; CLI-key carrier (GH_TOKEN injection) severed. The field was computed but disconnected from the return path. The fix was a two-line merge in applyProvisioningPlan + wiring in session-provisioning. Cost: round 1 code review caught this, round 2 verified the merge was in place. Lesson: production-wiring proof (one test driving the real route/handler, not a fabricated event) would have caught this pre-review.

Model choice mattered for live-proof determinism: haiku declined to call the loaded MCP tool (~50% flaky on cold runs), passed the trust/auth layer but narrated instead of invoking. Pinning sonnet fixed the issue — 3 cold runs all green, deterministic. The carrier mechanism (Bearer header + .mcp.json) was proven sound; the flakiness was haiku's tool-calling reluctance. Lesson: model-layer reliability must be verified in live-proof; haiku is not suitable for harness-validation gates where model behavior matters.

Per-harness live-proof matrix was the right shape after round 1-2 fixes: claude (Bearer MCP), codex (config.toml + env), opencode (inline header), CLI-key (env injection to real gh), builtin (scoped out with reason). Each carrier mapped to a real binary + real MCP server over real transport. The tamper test (wrong server-side auth) proved the sentinel (AN2_PROBE_OK) only appears on real token authentication — not vacuous. Codex/opencode carry over; claude now deterministic.

Architecture critique caught 5 findings (C1 builtin over-claim, W1 wrong lane, W2 redundant secret field, W3 SSRF residual boundary, W4 phantom harnessType variable) before code was written. All were fixable in the plan; some (C1, W1) re-shaped the validation strategy. The dual-write-site tension (#374: claude inline, codex/opencode via writeCliMcpConfig) was correctly identified and remains a future consolidation. Lesson: critique as a separate agent from design+architecture works — it found contradictions the planner did not see.

All 6 ACs met in round 3 final. Live-proof deterministic (sonnet, 3× cold green). Per-harness carriers proven (claude/codex/opencode via tamper, gh via success-only assertion). CLI-key merged + wired. Per-user isolation (single-founder model, resolver AND(userId)). Gate-free provisioning (no approval/broker, graceful-degradation try/catch matches concept hard-rule 1). Idempotence (pure read-projection of service_connections, AC4 integration proves byte-identical across respawn). Ready to ship.
